step.cmd: Determine the weekly pension amount to allocate as follows:

ul.li: Determine the client’s age.
Determine when the pension was paid or became payable.
If the lump-sum pension was paid or became payable prior to June 7, 2015, refer to Schedule II to find the appropriate weekly annuity equivalent for the client’s age. Schedule II

If the lump-sum pension was paid on June 7, 2015 or became payable after, refer to Digest 5.13.6.4 — Allocation of a lump-sum pension benefit to find the appropriate weekly annuity equivalent for the client’s age. Digest 5.13.6.4 — Allocation of a lump-sum pension benefit
Divide the lump-sum by 1 000.
Multiply the result by the previously identified weekly annuity equivalent.

step.cmd: Determine if the pension starts later than Monday of the first week:

ul.li: If no, go to step 12.

If yes, calculate the amount to allocate to the first week as follows:
If the allocation starts on a Tuesday, divide the weekly amount by 5 and multiply the result by 4.
If the allocation starts on a Wednesday, divide the weekly amount by 5 and multiply the result by 3.
If the allocation starts on a Thursday, divide the weekly amount by 5 and multiply the result by 2.
If the allocation starts on a Friday, divide the weekly amount by 5.

step.cmd: Determine if the following re-qualifier conditions are met to exempt the pension from allocation:

ul.li: If all conditions are met, the pension is exempt. Use “ Q ” when allocating.
If any condition is not met, the pension is not exempt. Use “ P ” when allocating.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the claim for benefits is active, terminated, blocked or archived:

ul.li: If the claim is active, go to step 14.

If the claim is terminated but can be reactivated, select the appropriate BPC on the Dormant tab and select Reactivate .
Go to step 14.
If the claim is blocked or archived, go to step 19.

step.cmd: Determine when the allocation must start:

ul.li: If the allocation must start on a Saturday, Sunday or Monday, go to step 15.
If the allocation must start on a Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday or Friday, go to step 16.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Allocations (M175) transaction and input the allocation as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

Type: Select the appropriate option:
P - Pension-not exempt
Q - Pension-exempt
Amount: Enter the amount determined in step 10.
Start date: Enter the first week the pension was paid.
End date: Select Indefinite .
Last week amount: Leave this field blank.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 8 - Your earnings were not deducted .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .
Select Update .
Go to step 17.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Allocations (M175) transaction and input the allocation as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

On the first line, select the appropriate attribute:
Type: Select P - Pension-not exempt or Q - Pension-exempt .
Amount: Enter the amount for the partial week determined in step 11.
Start date: Enter the first week the pension was paid.
End date: Enter the same week as the start date.
Last week amount: Leave this field blank.

On the second line, select the appropriate attribute:
Type: Select P - Pension-not exempt or Q - Pension-exempt .
Amount: Enter the weekly amount determined in step 10.
Start date: Enter the first week the pension was paid + 1.
End date: Select Indefinite .
Last week amount: Leave this field blank.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 8 - Your earnings were not deducted .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: On the Summary tab, determine if there is a stop payment related to these earnings:

ul.li: If no, go to step 18.

If yes, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and remove the stop payment as follows:
Registration number : Select the appropriate registration number.
Manual Action : Select the appropriate MA.
Rescind : Check the box.
Contentious : Select 1 - No.
Complete: To complete the registration number, select C - Yes . To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .
Select Update .
Go to step 18.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the allocation must also be input on a blocked claim:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 19.
If no, go to step 32.

step.cmd: On the Blocked tab, determine the code displayed in the Blocked Status column:

ul.li: If 1 - Updateable is displayed , go to step 20.
If 2 - Not blocked is displayed, return to step 13.
If any other code is displayed, go to step 29.

step.cmd: Review the Blocked Action Pending column:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, go to step 21.
If all rows are blank, go to step 23.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Waiting for an updateable BCS status.”
Bring forward date: Enter [the next business day].

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, in FTS, review the Blocked Action Pending column on the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, repeat step 21.
If all rows are blank, go to step 23.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the BPC you want to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, complete the following:

ul.li: Action required: Select Claim update .
Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised (or 2 - Renewal , if appropriate).
Contentious : Select 1 - No .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine when the allocation must start:

ul.li: If the allocation must start on a Saturday, Sunday or Monday, go to step 25.
If the allocation must start on a Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday or Friday, go to step 26.

step.cmd: On the Allocations tab, input the allocation in the Allocations section as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select A - Add .

Type: Select the appropriate option:
P - Pension-not exempt
Q - Pension-exempt
Amount: Enter the amount determined in step 10.
Start date: Enter the first week the pension was paid.
End date: Select Indefinite .
Last week amount: Leave this field blank.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 8 - Your earnings were not deducted .
Select Update .
Go to step 27.

step.cmd: On the Allocations tab, input the allocation in the Allocations section as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select A - Add .

On the first line, select the appropriate attribute:
Type: Select P - Pension-not exempt or Q - Pension-exempt .
Amount: Enter the amount of the partial week determined in step 11.
Start date: Enter the first week the pension was paid.
End date: Enter the same week as the start date.
Last week amount: Leave this field blank.

On the second line, select the appropriate attribute:
Type: Select P - Pension-not exempt or Q - Pension-exempt .
Amount: Enter the weekly amount determined in step 10.
Start date: Select the first week the pension was paid + 1.
End date: Select Indefinite .
Last week amount: Leave this field blank.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 8 - Your earnings were not deducted .
Select Update .

step.cmd: On the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction:

ul.li: If the transaction shown is incorrect, go to step 28.
If the transaction shown is correct, select Close and go to step 32.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.
Select Update .
Return to step 24.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS) : Check the box.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 8 - Your earnings were not deducted .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the correct BPC.
Work item: Select 91 - Overpayment .
Work type: Select 2 - Non-misrepresentation .
Remarks line 1: Type “Input M175 [Q or P] $[amount to allocate] from [first day of allocation] to [last day of allocation].”
Remarks line 2: Add allocation information if necessary.
Remarks line 5: Enter your name and telephone number.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: To transfer the registration number to IPOC, select the appropriate registration number from the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine if the pension was declared on the claimant’s report:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 33.
If no, go to step 34.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there are any rejected electronic claimant’s reports on the Pending/Reject tab:

ul.li: If no, go to step 34.
If yes, refer to Actioning a rejected claimant’s report to re-input the reports. Actioning a rejected claimant’s report

step.cmd: Determine the pension code used for the allocation. Refer to step 12 if necessary.

ul.li: If P - Pension-not exempt was used, go to step 35.
If Q - Pension-exempt was used, go to step 36.

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the D-20-16-03 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Allocations of earnings (2516)
Pension allocation (2525): Select the appropriate option.
Do not report monies already declared (2456)
Waiting Period Message (2444)

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the WI or return to the previous task.
